SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'SOIL' AS BUYER, PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, QTYUNIT AS UNIT_MEASURE, AMTUNIT AS CURRENCY_CODE, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, ITEM_AMT, ADD_DATE, RD_DATE, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PURCHASER_USER_ID, LEGACY_PR_NO || '-' || LEGACY_PR_SEQ AS LEGACY_PR_NO, REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REMARK, DELY_TO_LOCATION_ZIP || ' ' || DELY_TO_LOCATION_ADDR AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT FROM TBL_KEP_PO WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE TBL_KEP_PO SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND SYSID = 'PRD' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
